info.description: Personal finance tracker API. Money amounts are strings of integer minor units (e.g. "125050" = 1,250.50 in a 2-decimal currency), never JSON numbers; FX rates are decimal strings.

cookie.name: session
cookie.description: Set by POST /api/auth/login (web). Swagger UI on the same origin sends it automatically.

bearer.description: Native clients: the token from login/register with `X-Client: native`.

drawerStyle.description: null = client default (web: FORM, mobile: KEYPAD)

token.description: Only for native clients (`X-Client: native`). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

drawerStyle.description: null resets to the client default

openingBalance.description: Current balance as a decimal string in the base currency (at most its minor digits).

openingBalanceMinor.description: Balance before the first ledger row, minor units.

balanceMinor.description: Derived: opening + ledger, in the account currency.

balanceInBaseMinor.description: balanceMinor in the user base currency at the latest rate.

openingBalance.description: Current balance as a decimal string; negative for money owed.

currency.description: Only while the account has no transactions (else 409 ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_LOCKED).

excludeFromInsights.description: Excluded from the heatmap and largest purchase.

subcategoryId.description: Defaults to the category's first sub-category.

tags.description: Tag names; created on first use.

budgetId.description: 'auto' (default) = the budget of the category; null = no budget; a budget id = that budget. Expenses only.

amount.description: Decimal string in the account currency. Optional with splits (then it must equal their sum).

subcategoryId.description: Defaults to the category's first sub-category

splits.description: Expense only: one row per split, sharing a splitGroupId. Replaces categoryId.

recurring.description: Creates a rule; this record is occurrence #1.

toAmountMinor.description: Transfers: amount received, in the destination currency.

fxRate.description: Transfers between currencies: destination per source unit.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null at the end.

incomeMinor.description: Integer minor units (e.g. cents) as a string.

expenseMinor.description: Integer minor units (e.g. cents) as a string.

netMinor.description: Integer minor units (e.g. cents) as a string.
